evals.prompt: Сделай на prime-ui-kit редактор характеристик тарифа: у каждой характеристики есть иконка, название параметра, значение и цвет иконки. Первые три характеристики (сотрудники, хранилище, поддержка) всегда первые, остальные можно перетаскивать, добавлять и удалять.
evals.expected_output: One FieldList: one row per spec with the headings once, an icon-only Select and a ColorPresets swatch in compact columns, the first three rows pinned by getLocked, the rest reorderable.
expectations: The specs are a FieldList (or one grid row per record with the column headings rendered once), not a .map() of fields that each carry a label
The words «Иконка», «Параметр», «Значение» and «Цвет» appear as visible labels once each, not once per row
Each spec is one row: the icon and the color are compact controls (Select with only Select.TriggerIcon, ColorPresets) in the same row as the name and the value
The first three specs are pinned with getLocked (a lock in place of the handle) and the list is reorderable
No hint or paragraph explains that the first specs stay first
Every field in a row has an accessible name (the FieldList column heading or an aria-label)

evals.prompt: Добавь в карточку тарифа блок «Преимущества»: список коротких текстов, порядок важен, можно добавлять и удалять.
evals.expected_output: A one-column FieldList, reorderable, with createItem and an addLabel; no numbered labels, no heading per row.
expectations: The list is a FieldList with one column and reorderable
No label is numbered («Преимущество 1», «Пункт 2») and no field repeats the block heading as its visible label
The add button says what it adds («Добавить преимущество»)

evals.prompt: Нужен блок цены тарифа: базовая цена в месяц и её изменения с определённого месяца (с 1 июля другая цена и т.д.), плюс разовая плата за подключение в рублях, долларах и евро.
evals.expected_output: The base price is the first, pinned row of the same FieldList as its changes; the setup fee is three fields in one row under one heading, the currency inside each field.
expectations: The base price and its changes are one FieldList; the base row is pinned (getLocked) and comes first
The column headings of the price list appear once, not above every row
The currency or unit is shown once per field (Input.InlineAffix), not in the label as well
The three setup fees sit in one row under one group heading, each field named for assistive tech, not three labelled fields on their own lines

evals.prompt: Вот форма тарифа (evals/prime-ui-kit/files/plan-form.tsx). Добавь в неё поле «Пробный период, дней».
evals.expected_output: The agent audits the screen first and reports and fixes the shape bugs (labels per row, numbered labels, a split record, the explaining hint, the base price apart from its changes, three currency labels, the «ОК» button), then adds the field.
expectations: Before or with the change, the answer names the UX problems of the existing form (repeated labels, numbered labels, a record over two lines, an explaining hint, the deposit labels, a button without an object)
The specs become one row per record with the headings once (FieldList)
«Преимущество {n}» labels are gone
The submit button says the verb and the object («Сохранить тариф»), not «ОК»
The new field «Пробный период» has inputMode numeric and the unit «дней» in one place

evals.prompt: Сделай список счетов клиента с удалением строки. Удалённый счёт можно восстановить в течение нескольких секунд.
evals.expected_output: Delete at once and offer «Отменить» in a Notification (action, commit in onDismiss); no ConfirmDialog on each delete.
expectations: Deleting a row removes it at once and shows a Notification with an «Отменить» action
The deletion is committed in onDismiss when the toast leaves without an undo
No ConfirmDialog or «Вы уверены?» opens for a single reversible delete
The empty state of the list offers the next step, not just «Нет данных»

evals.prompt: Сделай форму выставления счёта: клиент, дата, позиции (услуга, количество, цена), итог внизу. Счёт уходит клиенту по почте.
evals.expected_output: A brief first; line items as a FieldList; the total through Intl; sending the invoice is an outward action that cannot be called back, so a ConfirmDialog names the client, the amount and the consequence; the primary button says «Выставить счёт».
expectations: The answer starts with a short brief: the person, the data and its shape, the main action, the states, the narrow screen
The line items are a FieldList with the headings once and an add button «Добавить позицию»
The total is formatted with Intl.NumberFormat ru-RU currency RUB
The primary button names the action and the object («Выставить счёт»)
Sending asks for confirmation in a ConfirmDialog that names the client, the amount and the consequence (the invoice goes to the client by email, «Счёт уйдёт клиенту на почту»), not «Вы уверены?»
The date defaults to today

evals.prompt: Сделай страницу поиска клиентов: поле поиска, под ним таблица результатов. Сервера пока нет — сымитируй запрос задержкой в полсекунды.
evals.expected_output: SmartFilter with fields={[]} in the page's Page.Toolbar, a DataTable with loading; the simulated request is cancelled when the query changes, so a slow answer never replaces a newer one.
expectations: The search is a SmartFilter (fields={[]}) in the page's Page.Toolbar inside Page.TopBar, not a bare Input above the table
The simulated request (setTimeout) is cleared, or its answer dropped, when the query changes again — in the effect's cleanup or through an AbortController
While a request runs the table keeps its rows with loading, and an empty result offers to reset the search

evals.prompt: Собери каркас приложения на prime-ui-kit: боковая навигация (Сделки, Клиенты, Задачи, Настройки), на телефоне навигация открывается кнопкой меню, и страница «Сделки» с заголовком и кнопкой «Новая сделка».
evals.expected_output: A root layout with AppShell, the Sidebar in AppShell.Nav and the page in AppShell.Main; the page renders its own Page.Root with a Page.TopBar; no menu state and no hand-made menu button — Page.TopBar draws the menu button while the Sidebar is off-canvas.
expectations: The frame holds no open / onOpenChange state for the Sidebar and no hand-made menu button with aria-expanded or onClick
The «Сделки» page renders its own Page.Root with Page.Title in Page.Header inside Page.TopBar; the frame has no header of its own
Every Sidebar.Item is a link (href or asChild) with a Sidebar.ItemIcon, and current marks the open page
«Новая сделка» is the page's one primary action in its top bar (Page.ToolbarActions or Page.Actions)
